High-quality mathematical explanations and computer science educational animations require three distinct typographic rendering pipelines:

items: **Multi-Channel Signed Distance Field (MSDF) Text**: Crystal-sharp text at any scale, camera distance, or rotation without texture pixelation.
**Mathematical LaTeX Formulas**: Full TeX/LaTeX equation parsing, layout, and conversion into animated vector contours.
**Syntax-Highlighted Code Blocks**: Syntax tokenization, themes, window chrome, and line-level animation mechanics.

blocks.content: For the comprehensive autonomous in-browser WebAssembly generation, two-tier caching, Brotli WOFF2 decompression, and contour-winding sanitizing architecture, refer to [`FONT_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md`](/notes-font-system-architecture).

blocks.text: Unlike standard monochrome SDFs which produce rounded corners when magnified, MSDF packs three independent distance fields into the RGB channels (representing signed distance to the closest edge curves).

In the fragment shader ([`TextFragment.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/fragment/TextFragment.ts)), the true signed distance is retrieved via the median operator with screen-space hardware derivative anti-aliasing:
This guarantees razor-sharp glyph corners at any camera zoom, rotation, or 4K resolution.

items: **Merged Mode (`isSplit: false`)**: Merges all characters in the string into a single quad-batch buffer. Maximises throughput for long labels and paragraphs.

items.text: **Split Mode (`isSplit: true`)**: Decomposes the string into individual [`SDFChar`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/SDFText.ts) child entities:
children: Enables per-glyph animations (such as [`Write`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/Write.ts), [`Typewriter`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/creation/Typewriter.ts), and staggered fades).
Each `SDFChar` supports interactive mouse raycasting (`raycast()` implementation) for cursor hover and click events.
Automatically propagates `z_index` and `layerMask` to prevent glyphs from falling behind other scene elements.

blocks.text: 2.5 Built-in Font Shortcuts for Text & SDFText (FontStyle)

Both [`Text`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/Text.ts) and [`SDFText`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/SDFText.ts) accept a `font` option typed as `OpentypeFont | FontStyle`. Passing a plain `FontStyle` string bypasses `FontLoader` entirely — the engine resolves, decompresses, and caches the font on first use via [`FontResolver`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/font/FontResolver.ts).

blocks.content: `FontStyle` is an open type: any Google Font family name (e.g. `"Cinzel Decorative"`) or font URL also works. Only the four aliases above are bundled; any other string is resolved through `FontResolver` as a Google Font or remote URL.
`Tex` does **not** use `FontStyle`. For formula font control see §3.1 below.

blocks.text: Retiam provides native LaTeX typesetting via a headless MathJax engine:
`Tex` accepts a `fontStyle?: TexStyle` option to switch the entire formula to a handwritten glyph set:

blocks.content: Each `TexStyle` runs in its own isolated MathJax document (`excalifontDoc`, `virgilDoc`, `defaultDoc`). This prevents prototype pollution when multiple `Tex` entities with different styles coexist in the same scene. Font patches are applied at document-creation time by cloning glyph entries in MathJax's internal SVG font variant tables.

items: **MathJax Compilation**: The LaTeX string is compiled into an SVG document using `mathjax-full` with full TeX packages (`AllPackages`).
**SVG Path Ingestion**: The resulting SVG glyph paths are parsed and normalized.
**World Coordinate Scaling**: SVG pixel coordinates are converted into Retiam world-space units via $s = \text{fontSize} / 1000.0$.

**Vector Path Generation**: Paths are ingested as [`SVGPath`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/svg/SVGPath.ts) and [`Path`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/2d/Path.ts) instances.

**Symbol Splitting**: When `split: true` is configured, each mathematical glyph (e.g. integral sign $\int$, superscript, fraction bar, denominator) is generated as an independent vector entity. This enables formula transitions such as [`TransformMatchingTex`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/transform/TransformMatchingTex.ts).

blocks.text: The `Code` composite entity provides educational code presentations:

items: **PrismJS Tokenizer**: Supports syntax parsing for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C, C++, Rust, Bash, JSON, CSS, and HTML/Markup.
**Window Chrome**: Optional macOS-style header bar with realistic close, minimize, and zoom traffic light buttons and centered window title.
